text:
ava: Heads up — we have a spike of customer SSO failures after last night's key rotation. Reports from Okta and AAD users getting 401 on login and SCIM sync returning 403. Paging SRE/security.
sam: Got dashboard link, seeing auth-proxy 401s and scim-service 403s. Sample log:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: saml signature verification failed: kid mismatch (expected kid rwd-old-2024, got rwd-new-2026)
ERROR scim-service: kms decrypt failed: envelope-header missing or unsupported (code=400)
```
Can confirm rotation job executed 02:14 UTC.
maria: Rotation job output shows new key alias rwd-idp-2026 created and used to rewrap a batch of service-account tokens. It looks like the proxy config still references the previous alias. Also SCIM service hasn't been given access to the new key IAM binding.
ava: OK — immediate mitigation options?
ben: Two options:
1) Re-add the old alias into proxy config and restart pods (fast).
2) Grant scim-service decrypt permission on new key and rewrap tokens (safer long term).
I can push option 1 now to stop the login failures while we sort IAM bindings.
opsbot: deploy: auth-proxy patch rolled out to rwd-auth-proxy (3/3 pods restarted) by ben at 02:28 UTC
sam: After restart, 200s for most tenants. Some SCIM 403s remain for tenants whose tokens were rewrapped with the new key and can't be decrypted by downstream tooling.
maria: Audit log snippet for SCIM 403s:
```
user=svc-scim@redwood prod=scim-service action=decrypt token_id=svc-12345 result=ERROR details="kms: envelope header 'x-kms-key-alias' not found"
```
Looks like the token envelopes lack the alias header expected by our KMS adapter. The rewrap process omitted metadata for older tokens.
ava: Impact scope?
ben: ~12 tenants had active provisioning flows when rotation executed. No auth tokens leaked, just failures to decrypt so provisioning/role assignment stalled. RBAC drift observed (users stuck in pending state).
sam: Short-term plan:
- ben: keep old alias in proxy for 1 hour as a fallback (done)
- maria: add scim-service to new-key IAM decrypt role (ongoing)
- sam: run rewrap job to re-encrypt service-account tokens with full envelope metadata (after IAM change)
maria: I've submitted IAM binding change — request id iam-change-842. Will take effect after principal acceptance (expect ~10min).
opsbot: iam-change-842: grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to serviceAccount:scim@redwood — requested at 02:33 UTC
sam: Running rewrap job now against tenant batch 1. Command:
```
./tools/rewrap_tokens --key-alias=rwd-idp-2026 --tenants=1..50
```
Will monitor.
maria: Rewrap logs show tokens now include envelope header and decrypt successfully against new key.
ben: After rewrap + proxy fallback, 95% of logins and 100% of queued SCIM retries succeeded. Remaining ~1 tenant needed manual user unlink/relink.
ava: Estimate resolution time?
ben: Service largely restored at 02:48 UTC. I'll keep fallback alias for 1 hour to avoid flapping while we validate the rest.
sam: Root cause: rotation runbook step omitted an IAM binding and our rewrap tool didn't preserve envelope metadata for older token types. Follow-ups:
- Add post-rotation smoke that triggers a SCIM provisioning check and login test for a canary tenant.
- Update rewrap tool to fail loudly if metadata would be lost.
- Add runbook step to pause traffic and run token verification for dependent services when rotating keys used for envelope-wrapped tokens.
ava: Filing postmortem and tagging action items. No PII exposed. Severity: Sev2 (partial outage for provisioning and SSO).
okta-bot: Okta integration alert cleared for tenants 1-50 at 02:50 UTC
ben: I'll open the runbook PR and the rewrap-tool fix. Assigning myself and maria for follow-ups. @sam can you take the postmortem write-up?
sam: On it, will include timeline and exact commands. Will also add a step to our CI that verifies KMS bindings before a rotation job runs.
ava: Thanks all. Great triage. Please add any lingering notes to the postmortem thread. :thumbsup
